entries.rationale: Mapping table fields and UNMAPPED handling fully specified, but judging which spec 'governs' a defect and MAPPED vs UNMAPPED calls needs interpretation; no golden sample for this git-archaeology pattern.
Prompt scope and the no-hand-computed-hash constraint are explicit, but actual prompt wording is original authoring; bundled prompts are shape reference only, not a curated sample.
review.yaml already has three reviewer entries of this exact schema, and the plan gives the literal YAML block to add; single-file edit with explicit positive-verification commands.

Plan itself flags this as the longest, highest-risk step with three named failure-mode traps (stale registry, wrong project root, wrong plugin root) and a VOID-vs-miss judgment call per run; no precedent for this scratch-worktree review-dispatch pattern exists.
Denominator/bar formula and the two-judgment rubric are exact, but applying 'defect named' and 'citation resolves' to each review's actual content is a judgment call with no sample precedent.

Three terminal states and required successor language are fully specified, but selecting the right outcome and confirming the regression/scope gates (npm test, adev diagnose, git diff --stat) touches two files and carries consequence beyond this task's own scope.
